summary: Reconciliation of the 24 legacy efficacy markdown sheets (efficacy/markdown/legacy/*.md, product-code-keyed) against the 70 new formula-keyed reports (efficacy/markdown/hygiene-skin-care/**, M000xxx formulas). Finding: the two sets cover ENTIRELY DIFFERENT product categories with zero overlap. The legacy 24 are hard-surface/general-purpose disinfectants, sanitizers, and virucides (floor/bathroom/food-contact-surface cleaners: Rest Stop, AF79, Pine Quat, Fight-Bac, GE Fight Bac, Glybet, Cide-bet, Sure Bet, Triforce, Quat-Stat, pH7Q, Sanibet, VersiFect, Daily Disinfectant Dual). The new 70 are all M000xxx hand-hygiene/skin-care formulas (Winning Hands hand soaps, Clario Ultra Blue, ethanol hand sanitizers). Different EPA registration numbers, different formula codes, different product identities, different label-claim families. As a result, NONE of the 24 legacy sheets are superseded by anything in the new 70-report set — classification instead reduces to internal duplicate detection within the legacy 24 themselves.
cross_reference_method: Read all 24 legacy files' frontmatter (formula_code, product_name, epa_reg_no) and body (organism/claim tables), and all 54 Master Version Table rows / 70 raw PDF filenames from B0-223. Matched on formula_code, product name, and EPA registration number. No formula_code, product name, or EPA reg number match was found between the legacy 24 and the new 70/54.
sql_footgun_check: Grepped all 24 legacy .md files for SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/CREATE TABLE/document_chunks/snowflake (case-insensitive) — none found embedded in any of the 24 files. The ticket's warned-about legacy Snowflake document_chunks SQL was not present in this batch of files; if it exists it lives elsewhere and was not touched or adapted here.
